node.math.compare.name: Compare
node.math.compare.description: Compare left and right numbers with <, ≤, > or ≥ and return true or false. The default is <. Decimal digits are not rounded. Numeric tokens are limited to 4096 characters and both written and normalized decimal exponents to Int32. Strings require explicit conversion.
node.math.equal.name: Is Equal
node.math.equal.description: Return whether left and right have equal values. No conversion between strings, numbers, booleans or bytes. JSON objects are compared by content; array order and string case matter. Numeric spelling alone does not change equality: 1 equals 1.0.
node.math.notEqual.name: Is Not Equal
node.math.notEqual.description: Return whether left and right differ, using the same rules as Is Equal. Both inputs are required; a missing input is an error, not a comparison result.
node.math.power.name: Power
node.math.power.description: Calculate base raised to exponent (2³ = 8). Inputs and results use finite binary64 numbers, with rounding. Negative bases require integer exponents. Non-real results, zero to a negative exponent, overflow and underflow fail. Zero to zero is 1.
node.math.root.name: Root
node.math.root.description: Calculate the degree-th root of value. Degree defaults to 2 (square root); use 3 for a cube root. Degree must be an integer from 1 to 2147483647. Negative values require an odd degree. Values and results use finite binary64 numbers, with rounding.
node.math.and.name: AND
node.math.and.description: Combine left and right: logical AND for two booleans, bitwise AND for two integers. Inputs must have the same kind; integers are checked exactly in the signed 64-bit range.
node.math.or.name: OR
node.math.or.description: Combine left and right: logical OR for two booleans, bitwise OR for two integers. Inputs must have the same kind; integers are checked exactly in the signed 64-bit range.
node.math.not.name: NOT
node.math.not.description: Invert value: logical NOT for a boolean, or bitwise complement for a signed 64-bit integer. Return the corresponding boolean or integer value.
node.math.nand.name: NAND
node.math.nand.description: Invert the AND of left and right. Use two booleans for logical NAND or two signed 64-bit integers for bitwise NAND.
node.math.nor.name: NOR
node.math.nor.description: Invert the OR of left and right. Use two booleans for logical NOR or two signed 64-bit integers for bitwise NOR.
node.math.xor.name: XOR
node.math.xor.description: Exclusive OR of left and right. For booleans, return true when exactly one is true. For signed 64-bit integers, XOR the bits.
node.math.ands.name: ANDS
node.math.ands.description: AND all elements of the value array. Accept 2 to 4096 booleans or signed 64-bit integers of the same kind. Return one boolean or integer. Every element is checked; missing, fractional or mixed values fail.
node.math.ors.name: ORS
node.math.ors.description: OR all elements of the value array. Accept 2 to 4096 booleans or signed 64-bit integers of the same kind. Return one boolean or integer. Every element is checked; missing, fractional or mixed values fail.
